mapper.update: UPDATE question SET title =#{title}, content =#{content}, answer =#{answer}, difficulty =#{difficulty}, category_id =#{categoryId} WHERE id =#{id} AND is_deleted =0
UPDATE question SET is_deleted =1 WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id,title,content,answer,difficulty,category_id, view_count,create_user_id,create_time,update_time,is_deleted FROM question WHERE id=#{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id,title,difficulty,category_id,view_count,create_time FROM question WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM question WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND LOWER(TRIM(title)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{title}))
SELECT title FROM question WHERE is_deleted = 0
